data.long_meaning: The name Eversole is derived from the Latin word 'Ever' meaning eternal and 'Sole' meaning sun. This name signifies a person who is as steadfast and enduring as the sun itself. The name Eversole carries the meaning “Eternal Sole” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eversole usually hope their child will grow to embody eternal sole and live with faith, good character and purpose.
